INDICATOR_NAME: Domestic general government health expenditure (% of general government expenditure)
SOURCE_NOTE: Public expenditure on health from domestic sources as a share of total public expenditure.  It indicates the priority of the government to spend on health from own domestic public resources.
SOURCE_ORGANIZATION: World Health Organization Global Health Expenditure database (http://apps.who.int/nha/database). The data was retrieved on April 15, 2024.
